about: Painter, oil on linen; symbolism and neoclassical portrait. Series I am a Planet and Silent Lights.
price_policy: All prices are in US dollars and already include worldwide shipping. Special requests (framing, custom sizes, commissions) are discussed with the artist personally.

artworks.title: Luna
artworks.description: In this piece, the Moon is depicted as a serene and empathetic figure, embodying the emotions, intuition, and nurturing qualities associated with the lunar symbol. The painting presents a strong feminine presence, with a soft palette of moonlit hues that evoke feelings of peace and introspection. The delicate contrast between the figure’s glowing eye and deep, cosmic background enhances the duality of light and shadow, emotion and intellect.

artworks.title: Sun
artworks.description: “Sun” symbolizes consciousness, creativity, and the power of self-expression. Though not a planet by definition, the Sun’s inclusion in the series reflects its significance in both astrology and mythology, embodying willpower, initiative, and the ability to create something unique. The vibrant palette of orange and gold enhances its life-giving energy, with the figure’s radiant crown emphasizing clarity and purpose.

artworks.title: Mercury
artworks.description: In this piece, “Mercury” represents intellect, curiosity, and the energetic flow of communication. The swirling winds of the planet are symbolized through the windswept hair of the figure, capturing the movement and freedom that define Mercury’s dynamic nature. The cold, gray-blue palette reflects the swift, cool, and analytical energy of this celestial body, while also emphasizing its constant motion and adaptability.

artworks.title: Venus
artworks.description: “Venus” embodies the duality of love and beauty alongside inner strength and rationality. As a symbol of affection and harmony, she radiates warmth and joy like the morning star she is often associated with. Her serene expression and the soft, golden light enveloping her reflect both outer beauty and a deep, genuine connection to love and relationships.

artworks.title: Mars
artworks.description: The painting “Mars” from the series “I am the Planet” embodies the symbolism of inner strength, striving for self-improvement and overcoming life’s obstacles. This image reflects the independence, determination and courage inherent in Mars as the god of war in mythology.

artworks.title: Jupiter
artworks.description: The painting “Jupiter” from the series “I am the Planet” reflects not only the greatness of the planet itself, but also its symbolic meaning. The girl depicted in the painting conveys the characteristic features of Jupiter — leadership, wisdom and the ability to make important decisions. Through her calm but powerful image, one can trace the strength and confidence that are peculiar to the planet.

artworks.title: Saturn
artworks.description: The painting “Saturn” from the series “I am the Planet” embodies the strict and powerful symbolism of this planet. Saturn is a planet of self-discipline and perseverance, reflecting the qualities that form our inner core. Restraint, insight and patience are the key characteristics of this job. It captures the moment of creative concentration, when a person, through hard work and prudence, attains harmony with himself and the world around him.

artworks.title: Uranus
artworks.description: The painting “Uranus” from the series “I am the Planet” embodies this distant and mysterious planet through the image of a girl shrouded in cold light. The girl with her eyes closed symbolizes detachment and inner concentration, reflecting the mystical nature of Uranus. Her calm expression emphasizes harmony and peace. The cold shades of blue and white convey the atmosphere of Uranus, saturated with methane.

artworks.title: Neptune
artworks.description: The Neptune is not an ordinary planet in our solar system. It symbolizes dreams and fantasies that are so difficult to comprehend and unravel. This is a world where each of us can dissolve into boundless creative inspiration, shrouded in riddles and mysteries.

artworks.title: Pluto
artworks.description: Pluto is a symbol of profound changes and hidden forces that control us from within. His influence is so powerful that it can affect entire masses of people, initiating transformation processes that change us on a fundamental level. In this painting, I strive to convey the mysterious and powerful essence of Pluto through the image of a girl, her penetrating gaze and ethnic jewelry, which enhance the effect of mystery and magnetism.

artworks.title: A Moment in Silence
artworks.description: A painting in which light and shadows merge into a single whole, creating a feeling of calm and deep thoughtfulness. The heroine’s inner world, as if hushed on the border of the past and the future, reflects her emotions with soft iridescences of light on her face and flaming hair. This work immerses the viewer in a state of peace, in the very silence where important discoveries and realizations are born. The painting conveys the feeling of a solitary moment when time seems to freeze, and there is only the opportunity to meet with oneself alone.

artworks.title: Waiting for the Dawn
artworks.description: “Waiting for the Dawn” is a picture full of quiet premonition and inner light that is about to spill out. The heroine is on the border of night and morning, where the shadows of the past are gradually receding, and a new day is flickering ahead. Her gaze is filled with calm confidence, as if she already knows what the dawn will bring. The warm shades of hair symbolize the inner fire and vital energy ready to come out. This is a work about anticipation, about the moment when everything freezes before the start of a new stage.

artworks.title: Unspoken
artworks.description: Sometimes words freeze on the lips, without being born with a sound. They remain inside — like a slight tremor in the air, like a feeling that cannot be conveyed. “Unspoken” is a moment of silence filled with meaning, it is an emotion that lives deeper than words.

artworks.title: Between Sleep and Dawn
artworks.description: The moment when everything freezes. The painting conveys that shaky, almost weightless boundary between the inner and the outer, between the vulnerable silence of sleep and the beginning of a new day.

artworks.title: The Flame That Doesn’t Burn
artworks.description: There is a warm power in this image that does not require proof. Waves of hair, like flames, gently flow down, but there is no destruction in them — only life, freedom and inner stability. The heroine’s closed eyes speak of trust in the world and in herself. This is not a fire that they escape from, but one that they reach out to to keep warm.

artworks.title: I Hear
artworks.technique: Oil and oil pastel on canvas
artworks.description: “I Hear” is not about sounds, but about attention. It’s a reminder of the difference between just listening and really listening.

artworks.title: Right in the Heart
artworks.technique: Oil and oil pastel on canvas
artworks.description: This view is not ignored. He’s like an arrow — accurate, deep, honest. There is no shadow of aggression in him, no desire to please. Only openness and inner strength.

artworks.title: Simple Presence
artworks.description: “Simple Presence” is a portrait about the power of being yourself — without words, without trying to appear. The look is filled with inner peace, and the light gently highlights the vibrant warmth of the skin. It’s at times like this that it feels like people are really looking at you. Against a dark background, simplicity becomes expressive.

artworks.title: A Look Through Time
artworks.description: This work is painted in oil on linen canvas. A realistic portrait on a warm background with reflections of light from the tree crown, create an image in which the personal and the eternal are intertwined. The main idea is to stop the moment and show the depth of the human gaze, which reflects both the experience and the anticipation of the future. The heroine’s face is filled with soft vulnerability, but also with inner strength, which is felt in her calm directness.

artworks.title: In the Arms of Peace
artworks.description: In this work, peace appears as something alive, as if he himself is able to embrace and protect. The naked back, softly covered with a blanket, symbolizes vulnerability and trust in the world, and the sliding light turns a moment of silence into a fragile and precious experience.

artworks.title: Before the Word
artworks.description: The moment before the word is spoken, when the thought has not yet become a word, and the feelings are still searching for form. This is a state of inner presence and focus, where silence speaks louder than any sound.

artworks.title: Looking at Art
artworks.description: The work addresses the theme of contemplation and dialogue between the viewer and the visible. The figure is depicted in a stream of evening light, facing the wall, where the shadow and light form a simple but expressive composition. The moment when reality itself becomes art — without intention, without the artist’s gesture. Here light acts as a painter, the shadow as a form, and space as a canvas. It’s as if the girl is looking not only at the wall but also within herself: by observing the play of light, she becomes a part of this silence, a part of the very act of contemplation.

artworks.title: I See
artworks.description: “I See” is a look inside and out at the same time. It contains not just a pupil and light, but experience, pain, sensitivity and silence. One eye as a symbol of observation, inner light and honesty with oneself.

artworks.title: Pearl
artworks.description: This work is about the silence in which we begin to hear. About the willingness to listen not only to the words, but also to the pauses between them. About attention as a deep form of love.

artworks.title: One Look
artworks.description: Sometimes one look is enough to read an entire story. In this look there is anxiety, vulnerability, an attempt to understand and be understood. It’s like he’s asking a question, but without words.

artworks.title: Her Dawn
artworks.description: “Her dawn” is a feeling of light that is already there, even before the start of the day. The tilt of the head, the open gaze and the relaxed pose speak of trust in this condition, without tension.

artworks.title: Nothing is Happening
artworks.description: A state of rest in which there is no need to be productive, collected, or helpful. It’s about the rare moment when you can afford to stop, do something insignificant, or do nothing at all — without feeling guilty and without expectations.

artworks.title: Touching the Light
artworks.description: Sometimes a patch of sunlight on a wall is enough to make you stop and simply look. I am fascinated by how light and shadow change familiar things and turn an ordinary moment into something beautiful. This work seems to speak about attention to such small things — about the ability to notice beauty in the everyday and to take pleasure in the moment itself.

artworks.title: Glance
artworks.description: I wanted to portray an inner contact — when a glance becomes a way to see and be seen. One eye as the center of attention and a symbol of presence: without words, without evaluation, just the fact of a live look.
